name: Berry Green 510 Cart | Blueberry Mint
description:
Cool, calm, and dangerous. Smooth mint with a wild kick — this one bites back.

Born to Burn, built to blaze, Berry Green is for the ones who don’t fade, don’t fold, don’t stop. When the night ends, the flame keeps burning.
